主要内容: On December 31, 2013, Asta Funding, Inc. (ASFI) acquired 100% of CBC Settlement Funding, LLC and its affiliate, CBC Management Services, LLC, for approximately $5.9 million through a subsidiary, CBC Acquisition LLC. The acquisition included a $5 million financing commitment to CBC, which manages structured settlements and annuity policies. CBC holds a portfolio of structured settlements with a future value exceeding $44 million, financed by $25 million in debt, including a $12.5 million line of credit (set to increase to $15 million). The deal was formalized via the Membership Interest Purchase Agreement (MIPA), which includes an 18-month indemnity with a $2 million cap. CBC's eligible receivables acquired since October 1, 2013, were valued at $5,650,000 plus $250,000, representing 80% of their net present value. The Operating Agreement outlines profit and loss allocation, with distributions based on cash flows and costs. Non-compete clauses restrict members from soliciting customers or employees for 24 months post-termination. Skyrm and Goodman may require CBC to buy their interests if terminated without cause, provided they hold the Requisite Percentage and CBC is not insolvent.
